name: San Juan · Puerto Rico
tagline: Old forts, colourful streets and a rainforest nearby
summary: San Juan pairs the blue cobbles and pastel houses of Old San Juan with massive Spanish forts and lively beaches. Nearby are El Yunque rainforest and glowing bioluminescent bays.
seasonNote: December to April is driest. Hurricane season June to November.
arrival: Luis Muñoz Marín Airport is 20 minutes away. US entry rules apply.
gettingAround: Walk Old San Juan; Uber; rent a car for the island.
cashTip: US dollars; cards work almost everywhere. Carry small bills for kiosks and tips.
foodTip: Mofongo, alcapurrias and piña colada (invented here).
